biggest_catch: The program no longer exists: Gemini Earn was discontinued in January 2023 after Genesis froze withdrawals in November 2022 — and even when it ran, it paid interest on YOUR OWN crypto deposits, never free money.
catches: Gemini Earn was discontinued in January 2023; Genesis Global Capital (the lending partner) filed for bankruptcy the same month.

Withdrawals froze in November 2022, locking ~$940M from 340,000 users; the program only wound down through bankruptcy recoveries (users received ~$2.18B in assets by May 2024; SEC case dismissed with prejudice in 2026 after full recovery).
It was a yield-on-your-own-assets product (up to 7.4% APY), not a way to make money without putting money in — the catalog's '3-8% APY on held crypto' was never free money.
No Gemini Earn product is currently offered; Gemini has not relaunched any earn/lending program.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee — moot, the program is gone.

c4.evidence: No payout is currently available: Gemini Earn was discontinued in January 2023 after the Genesis bankruptcy; it no longer accepts deposits or pays yield.

eligibility: Not applicable — the program no longer exists; no one can enroll or earn.
notes: Death evidence 2026-09-23: Gemini Earn (launched Feb 2021, up to 7.4% APY on crypto lent through Genesis) froze withdrawals in November 2022; Earn was discontinued in January 2023 and Genesis filed for bankruptcy that month; the SEC charged Gemini and Genesis over the unregistered offering (dismissed with prejudice in 2026 after full investor recovery). Users ultimately recovered ~$2.18B in digital assets through the bankruptcy process — this was a wind-down, not a relaunch. Mechanically, Earn was always interest on the user's own deposited crypto, so it never fit 'make money without spending money' anyway. No commits, no DB writes.
